public_donors.title: Commons / Wikipedia / Wikidata links
public_donors.credit: Jarekt (source work); Visite fortuitement prolongee (derivative work)
public_donors.motif: Explicit directional edges across different information systems
public_donors.accessible_twin: Boxes for Commons, Wikipedia and Wikidata, connected by arrows labelled with specific linkage operations.
public_donors.inverse_challenge: Do arrows represent actual reciprocal relationships, or only a proposed mapping?
public_donors.next_test: Use one source-linked CoMap graph; require distinct status and inverse semantics on each directional edge.

public_donors.title: Gas Planet Orbits (PIA17304)
public_donors.stated_license: NASA media guidelines; specific item credits NASA/Lunar and Planetary Institute; item-level rights review required
public_donors.motif: Concentric orbital scale with a visible measurement legend
public_donors.accessible_twin: Approximate distances of Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune from the Sun, using a shared legend and scale.
public_donors.inverse_challenge: Is this scale exact for every distance, and is the visual orbital layout a dynamic measurement?
public_donors.next_test: Render one CoOrb scale metaphor beside source-linked units and a clear conceptual-only label on the UI metaphor.

public_donors.title: RDF 1.2 Primer: multiple graphs
public_donors.origin: W3C RDF & SPARQL Working Group draft
public_donors.stated_license: No diagram-specific re-use license independently qualified in this wave
public_donors.motif: Named/default graphs and source-bound, typed subject-predicate-object relations
public_donors.accessible_twin: Two scopes describe relationships involving people, documents and artwork, with explicitly typed directional predicates.
public_donors.inverse_challenge: Does sharing a visual node imply the same graph scope, provenance or authority?
public_donors.next_test: Create one CoMap named-graph example with source provenance and a negative test for cross-graph conflation.

public_donors.title: Linked Commons network viewer
public_donors.stated_license: Source webpage reviewed; embedded screenshot image-specific permissions were not established
public_donors.credit: Creative Commons Open Source / Linked Commons contributors
public_donors.motif: Explore many linked nodes by filtering, rather than displaying the entire graph at once
public_donors.accessible_twin: An interactive graph provides a text search to focus a subset of linked sources and their connections.
public_donors.inverse_challenge: Does visual size or connection count masquerade as importance, authority or source independence?
public_donors.next_test: Compare CoOrb focus-plus-neighbors against a text-first list in a bounded first-use task.
